outcome: Comparing a pydantic URL with a type that knows how to compare itself to one gives that type's answer rather than an unconditional False

acceptance_criteria.text: Comparing a URL to an object of a foreign class that defines equality against URLs yields that class's answer.

expected_verification.assertion: a foreign class whose __eq__ accepts a URL compares equal to one, in both operand orders

acceptance_criteria.text: Comparing two URLs of the same class still compares by value, and comparing to an unrelated object is still not equal.

expected_verification.assertion: the existing URL equality and inequality tests still pass
